A note from the founder

Hi, I'm Christina.

I've been a digital nomad for over a decade. I launched Rise Remotely 1.0 in 2021 to help people work better remotely. It helped people grow. But I realized something was missing.

People were making surface-level changes without ever understanding what was actually driving their behaviour. So I rebuilt the entire platform around revealing those deeper patterns.

I'm on a mission to help as many people meet themselves so deeply that they can live the life they long for.
